deep_dive.executive_summary: AJG is a global insurance broker with sticky commission revenue, a long acquisition track record, and durable local-agency relationships. FY2025 free cash flow per share is about $6.72 after estimated maintenance capex. At ~$254 (July 2026), total synthesis implies 2.29% per year over 7 years on filing-based owner cash. Moat is stable (switching costs, local relationships) but not wide. Partial dhando because net debt (~$47 per share) and AssuredPartners integration risk cap the bear case. method_fit.label: High-return compounder
applicability_tests: Owner earnings can be separated from stock compensation, working capital, and maintenance capital.
Incremental returns on retained capital are observable and durable.
The competitive advantage explains pricing, retention, share, or cost outcomes.
Terminal value is supported by a reinvestment runway rather than an unexplained multiple.
failure_modes: growth projected without its capital cost
terminal value unsupported by a durable mechanism

validation_cohort.purpose: Test depletion, commodity exposure, finite reserves, and royalty-unit reconciliation.

industry.trend: Commercial insurance pricing cycle (hard/soft market) drives commission growth; interest expense rises with acquisition debt; consolidation continues as brokers roll up local agencies.
